name: Agent tool gate
subject: Shell commands an agent wants to run, gated by risk. The gate tightens the agent's own permissions; it loosens them only through the opt-in allow gate (REFLEX_ALLOW=on, enforce mode).

denyAt.label: Deny at blast
denyAt.note: Blast score at which a production command is refused outright.

askAt.label: Ask at blast
askAt.note: Blast score at which a human confirms before the command runs.

unsureBelow.label: Ask when blast confidence below
unsureBelow.note: Spread-out blast answers on a mutating command get a human look.

onTaskFloor.label: Ask when on-task below
onTaskFloor.note: How sure we must be that a mutating command serves the agent's stated task.

allowBlastMax.label: Allow at blast up to
allowBlastMax.note: Highest blast score a command may have to run without the agent's own prompt (REFLEX_ALLOW).

allowConfidence.label: Allow when blast confidence at least
allowConfidence.note: Jev must be this sure of the blast score.

allowRiskBelow.label: Allow when mutates, exfil and injection below

allowOnTask.label: Allow when on-task at least
allowOnTask.note: A missing on-task answer (a cached one) never allows.

taintAskAt.label: Tainted session: ask at blast
taintAskAt.note: After the agent read a suspected prompt injection (the injection guard), a lower blast threshold for asking.

taintOnTask.label: Tainted session: ask when a mutation's on-task below

taintStrict.label: Stricter after a suspected prompt injection

deny.label: Deny
deny.blurb: Refused; the agent must find another way

allow.label: Allow
allow.blurb: Clearly safe; runs without the agent's own prompt when REFLEX_ALLOW=on

gates.label: Talking to the reviewer?
gates.rule: command text tries to influence its own review

gates.label: Secrets or data leaving?
gates.rule: may read secrets or send data out

gates.label: Tainted: any sign of data leaving?
gates.rule: may send data out, in a session that read a suspected prompt injection

gates.label: Tainted: more than a local change?
gates.rule: blast {blast} at or above {$taintAskAt}, in a session that read a suspected prompt injection

gates.label: Tainted: a mutation off the stated task?
gates.rule: does not clearly match the stated task, in a session that read a suspected prompt injection

gates.label: Off the stated task?
gates.rule: does not match what the agent said it was doing

gates.label: Clearly safe?
gates.test: blast <= $allowBlastMax and blast.confidence >= $allowConfidence and mutates < $allowRiskBelow and exfil < $allowRiskBelow and injection < $allowRiskBelow and on_task >= $allowOnTask and env == 'local'
